transfer implementation: checks balances[msg.sender] >= _value and _value > 0, then updates balances of sender and recipient
transferFrom implementation: checks balances[_from], allowed[_from][msg.sender] and _value > 0, then moves balances and decreases allowance
balanceOf implementation returning balances[_owner]
approve implementation writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emitting Approval
allowance implementation returning allowed[_owner][_spender]
fallback function that throws when plain ether is sent to the contract
constructor that mints initial balances[msg.sender] and totalSupply and sets name, decimals and symbol
approves _spender, emits Approval and then performs a low-level _spender.call to receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes)
caller controlled address used for balance/allowance indexing, initial minting and as _from in the external call
low-level _spender.call(bytes4(sha3('receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes)')), msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) executed after allowance is set, enabling reentrancy
unchecked arithmetic balances[msg.sender] -= _value and balances[_to] += _value under Solidity 0.4 semantics
unchecked arithmetic balances[_to] += _value, balances[_from] -= _value and allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
